title: fix(console): About names the ObjectStack version first, then the console build
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6okWxYPWAsooBsJoAhnT1u)_

Fixes #35280

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户打开「帮助 → 关于」时,先看到 ObjectStack 版本号(如 18.5.0),再看到原有的控制台构建号;以前只有构建号。
- 属于控制台体验修缮:管理员和支持人员查版本、做升级核对时不必再去调接口。
- 若读取失败,版本一行会用文字说明「未知版本」,不会留空;改动只在对话框内,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Help → About now opens on an **ObjectStack version** row, then the existing **Console build** row.

- The version is the `version` the discovery document answers, shown verbatim (an operator's `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` stamp included, per ruling A on #34774). It is read through the shell's adapter (`useAdapter().getDiscovery()`), which returns the document the adapter's `connect()` already holds from the console's one shared discovery read (`getSharedDiscovery`). Opening the dialog sends no new request, and no second version source is added.
- While the read is in flight the row shows `common.loading`. When discovery cannot be read (the adapter answers `null`) or names no version, the row says so in words: "Unknown version (the server did not report one)". The field is never empty.
- New keys `help.aboutVersion` and `help.aboutVersionUnknown` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`). `help.aboutDescription` now names both rows.
- `AboutDialog.tsx`'s module doc no longer says the shell has no request that reads the runtime version.
- The bug-report and feature-request templates' Version hint now points at "the ObjectStack version shown under About".
- No server, `packages/spec` or discovery-shape change. No props or exports change.

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AboutDialog.tsx`: the `useRuntimeVersion` hook (the read, the `undefined`/`null`/string states) and the two `dl` rows.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970.test.tsx`: the new top-level describe.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`: the three `help.about*` lines (the other ten packs mirror them).

Two-minute check: run `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970.test.tsx`. You should see 15 tests pass. Or open Help → About in a running console: the first row is "ObjectStack version" with the same value as `GET /api/v1/discovery`, and "Console build" is the second row.

## Tests

The new pins are a top-level describe in the existing About harness, `AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970.test.tsx`. They are not in a sibling file because AGENTS.md puts a new pin into a component's existing shared harness (ruling record 6583487846). The new cases check:

- Discovery answering `18.5.0`, and a stamped `18.6.0-rc.2+deploy.41`, fills the first row with exactly that text. The `dt` order is version then build, and the build row still shows its sha.
- Discovery that cannot be read (`null`), that names no version, or that names an empty version shows `help.aboutVersionUnknown`, never an empty field.
- While the read is pending the row shows `common.loading`.

<details><summary>Local runs at head 32984388e, under the shared verify lock</summary>

- The pin file: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 15 passed (15).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: Test Files 105 passed (105), Tests 1962 passed, 13 skipped. This covers the key-parity suites.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (both `tsc` programs, including `tsconfig.test.json`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one mutation per leg, each landed and restored on disk by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs</summary>

Each mutation was restored and checked: blob equals HEAD 0aabb5984a63 and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| Mutation | Pin file result |
|---|---|
| read: `setVersion(discoveryVersion(discovery))` becomes `setVersion(null)` | 2 failed, 13 passed |
| fallback: `help.aboutVersionUnknown` becomes `common.loading` | 3 failed, 12 passed |
| loading: loading text becomes `null` | 1 failed, 14 passed |
| order: build row moved above the version row | 2 failed, 13 passed |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The discovery read reuses the adapter the help menu already holds. Nothing in the shell kept the parsed discovery document in React state: `useDiscovery` in `@object-ui/react` reads `SchemaRendererContext`, which the console header does not sit under. `adapter.getDiscovery()` is the existing holder.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**` is not a governed surface: it has no row in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`, which holds only `.github/workflows/**`. The wording change is in this PR.
- No `content/docs/frontend` page or package README names the About dialog, so no docs page changes.
- Not measured locally:
  - `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. Its closure build never got the verify lock (queue-timeout).
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: lock queue-timeout, exit 99. This diff touches no `ui/scripts/` file.
  - CI's Test UI and the type-check lanes run both of these.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gate subset (derived by dispatch-gates --commands from this diff)</summary>

- 46 of the 48 derived commands, plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`, exited 0. This includes `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files`, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:undeclared-dep-imports`.
- Two commands were not measured, both listed above.
- `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean (main and #36234 / #36223, which share the locale files, merge cleanly).

</details>
